purpose: Cross-link Phase 3 immutable captures to Phase 4 release-window traces before any window can enter the empirical shadow-campaign ledger.
hypothesis: A deterministic evidence-enrollment gate can prove that every referenced pre-release and release component exists in the immutable capture store, matches receive clocks and payload identities, agrees with the actual store audit, and cannot promote synthetic evidence.

decision_rule.READY_FOR_LICENSED_EVIDENCE_ENROLLMENT: The offline cross-link, store-integrity, replay, ledger and failure-injection checks pass exactly as preregistered.
decision_rule.FAIL_EVIDENCE_ENROLLMENT: A capture reference, clock, payload identity, store claim, ledger, preregistration or test gate fails.
decision_rule.PROMOTE_SHADOW_CAMPAIGN: Reserved for six distinct enrolled licensed windows, including three CPI and three NFP windows.

economic_decision: No market-price join or model fitting is authorized until the registered licensed campaign threshold is met and a separate price trial is preregistered.
out_of_scope: opening an authenticated connection without user-supplied credentials and written rights
treating a trace assertion as proof of raw-store integrity
counting synthetic or documentation payloads as empirical evidence
